professionalSummary: Machine learning engineer with five years of experience developing failure‑prediction models for industrial air compressors using vibration and temperature telemetry.
Owner of a production bearing‑failure model, responsible for approving retraining releases and threshold adjustments.
Designed and maintained telemetry ingestion pipelines that resample controller data into ten‑minute windows and load features into an analytics warehouse.
Collaborated with field‑service engineers to review alerts and refine model performance.
Participated in a pilot deploying a compressed model onto compressor controllers in a test environment.
experienceHighlights: Developed failure‑prediction models from equipment telemetry (src_4e8d6c5b52f2).
Acted as registered owner of the bearing‑failure model, approving six retraining releases and two threshold changes (src_b3dd41af97b3).
Built telemetry ingestion pipeline with daily completeness checks (src_2f3ed064cd8e).
Reviewed monthly alerts with field‑service engineers, adjusting review lists based on inspection findings (src_800d5bb443c8).
Took part in a three‑month trial deploying a compressed model onto two compressor controllers in the company’s test hall (src_da8fd662db12).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Model‑register entry for the bearing‑failure model, showing ownership, approval history, and alert‑review log for March 2024 (src_df445913aeed).
